projects.title: FinSync — Expense Tracker
projects.description: A full-stack real-time expense tracking platform built using React, Supabase, and TailwindCSS with features like company creation, shared expenses, and reimbursements.

projects.title: HealthBuddy — Digital EHR Platform
projects.description: A cross-platform EHR system built using Supabase, React, and React Native with real-time patient data sharing and secure access control using Row-Level Security.

projects.title: PrepBuddy — AI Teaching Assistant
projects.description: An AI-powered web platform using Flask, LangChain, and multiple LLMs to generate summaries and quiz questions from uploaded study material or YouTube links.
